description: Defines the NoteRecyclerAdapter class for managing and displaying Note objects in a RecyclerView, including diffing logic and payload handling.

classes.name: NoteRecyclerAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for binding Note data to RecyclerView items with diffing and payload optimization.

classes.name: DiffCallback
classes.description: Inner class for calculating differences between Note items for efficient updates.

classes.name: Payload
classes.description: Enum representing different types of data changes in Note items.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new NoteViewHolder.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the ViewHolder, with payload handling for partial updates.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns the unique ID of the Note at the given position.

methods.name: submitList
methods.description: Updates the adapter's data set and manages visible/hidden notes.

methods.name: flattenPayloads
methods.description: Utility function to flatten a list of payloads into a set of Payload enums.
